brief:
Israeli occupation forces arrested a young man from Beit Ulla, located west of Hebron in the occupied West Bank, on Saturday, Shehab Wire reported. The arrest took place during an operation in which soldiers also physically assaulted several other residents of the town.

The circumstances surrounding the arrest remain unclear. Authorities have not released information about the detainee's identity, the stated reason for his detention, or details about those who were assaulted during the raid.
